title: Our new neighbour
description: A monologue lesson about Nigel, a pilot who is the family's new next-door neighbour. He was in the Royal Air Force, is only forty-one years old, and has already been to nearly every country in the world. He is currently in Madrid, will fly to New York next month, and Tokyo the month after next, and will return to London the week after next. Nigel is described as a very lucky man, but his wife isn't very lucky because she usually stays at home. New vocabulary includes pilot, return, New York, Tokyo, Madrid, and fly. Workbook practice covers answering comprehension questions about the text and matching cities with countries before writing sentences about Nigel's travels. Grammar exercises practise asking and answering questions with shall/will using given cues, and completing dialogues using the cues given.
answer_note: Lesson listening question (Why is Nigel a lucky man) is a suggested model answer based on the text. Practice A (comprehension) 12 questions have suggested model answers derived from the text; no official key is available in the workbook key scan. Practice B (match cities and write sentences) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-5 are suggested model answers. Grammar I (ask and answer) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 93 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 508-509). Grammar II (complete the dialogues) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 93 grammar key (PDF viewer p. 509). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen then answer this question. Why is Nigel a lucky man?
听录音，然后回答问题。为什么说奈杰尔很幸运？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer the question: Why is Nigel a lucky man?

lesson.text:
Nigel is our new next-door neighbour.
He's a pilot.

He was in the R.A.F.

He will fly to New York next month.

The month after next he'll fly to Tokyo.

At the moment, he's in Madrid.
He flew to Spain a week ago.

He'll return to London
the week after next.

He's only forty-one years old,
and he has already been
to nearly every country in the world.

Nigel is a very lucky man.
But his wife isn't very lucky.
She usually stays at home!
lesson.translation:
奈杰尔是我们新搬来的隔壁邻居。他是个飞行员。
他曾在皇家空军任职。
下个月他将飞往纽约。
再下个月他将飞往东京。
现在他在马德里。他是一星期以前飞到西班牙的。
再下个星期他将返回伦敦。
他只有41岁，但他却去过世界上几乎每一个国家。
奈杰尔是个很幸运的人。但他的妻子运气不好。她总是呆在家里！

questions.prompt: Why is Nigel a lucky man?
questions.answer: Nigel is a very lucky man because he's only forty-one years old and he has already been to nearly every country in the world.

items.title: next-door neighbour
items.text: next-door neighbour, 隔壁邻居。next-door 是一个复合词，作定语。

items.title: the R.A.F.
items.text: the R.A.F. = the Royal Air Force, 英国皇家空军。

items.title: He is only forty-one years old, and he has ...
items.text: 本句中的 and 相当于 but（而……），起转折作用。

practice.title: A — Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the text on Students' Book page 189 and answer these questions. 参见学生用书第189页上的课文，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: Read the lesson text and answer each question.

questions.prompt: Who is Nigel?
questions.answer: Nigel is our new next-door neighbour.

questions.prompt: What does he do?
questions.answer: He's a pilot.

questions.prompt: What was he in?
questions.answer: He was in the R.A.F. (the Royal Air Force).

questions.prompt: Where will he fly next month?
questions.answer: He will fly to New York next month.

questions.prompt: What will he do the month after next?
questions.answer: He'll fly to Tokyo the month after next.

questions.prompt: Where is he at the moment?
questions.answer: He's in Madrid at the moment.

questions.prompt: What did he do a week ago?
questions.answer: He flew to Spain a week ago.

questions.prompt: When will he return to London?
questions.answer: He'll return to London the week after next.

questions.prompt: How old is he?
questions.answer: He's only forty-one years old.

questions.prompt: Where has he already been?
questions.answer: He has already been to nearly every country in the world.

questions.prompt: Is his wife very lucky?
questions.answer: No, his wife isn't very lucky.

questions.prompt: Why isn't she very lucky?
questions.answer: Because she usually stays at home.

practice.title: B — Vocabulary: Match cities with countries and write sentences
practice.instruction:
Match the cities with the countries, then write possible sentences about Nigel below. 为第一栏中的城市找出其所在国家的名称，然后根据奈杰尔的情况造句。

Cities: New York, Tokyo, Berlin, Bombay, Sydney, Madrid, Moscow, Rome, Geneva, Paris, Beijing, Athens
Countries: Japan, Greece, America, Germany, China, India, Switzerland, Spain, Russia, Italy, Australia, France

Example (item 1): Last week he flew to Madrid in Spain.
practice.translation: Match each city with its country, then write five sentences about Nigel's travels following the printed example.

questions.prompt: Last week he flew to ______ in ______.
questions.answer: Madrid, Spain

questions.prompt: Write a sentence about Tokyo.
questions.answer: Last month he flew to Tokyo in Japan.

questions.prompt: Write a sentence about New York.
questions.answer: Next month he will fly to New York in America.

questions.prompt: Write a sentence about Beijing.
questions.answer: Two years ago he flew to Beijing in China.

questions.prompt: Write a sentence about Sydney.
questions.answer: The year before last he flew to Sydney in Australia.

grammar.title: I. Ask and answer questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词提问并回答。
grammar.instruction:
Ask and answer questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词提问并回答。

Example (item 1):
you/have a haircut/next week/last week
Will you have a haircut next week?
No, I won't. I had a haircut last week.
grammar.translation: Ask a question and give a short answer using the cues, following the printed example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf
grammar.context: 10 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 93 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 508-509).

questions.prompt:
1. you/have a haircut/next week/last week
Will you have a haircut next week?
No, I won't. I had a haircut last week.
questions.answer:
Will you have a haircut next week?
No, I won't. I had a haircut last week.

questions.prompt: 2. she/clean the kitchen/tomorrow morning/yesterday morning
questions.answer:
Will she clean the kitchen tomorrow morning?
No, she won't. She cleaned the kitchen yesterday morning.

questions.prompt: 3. they/go to London/next month/last month
questions.answer:
Will they go to London next month?
No, they won't. They went to London last month.

questions.prompt: 4. he/visit Seoul/next May/last May
questions.answer:
Will he visit Seoul next May?
No, he won't. He visited Seoul last May.

questions.prompt: 5. you/play football/tomorrow afternoon/yesterday afternoon
questions.answer:
Will you play football tomorrow afternoon?
No, I/we won't. I/We played football yesterday afternoon.

questions.prompt: 6. your son/go to England/next year/last year
questions.answer:
Will your son go to England next year?
No, he won't. He went to England last year.

questions.prompt: 7. they/fly to Rome/the month after next/the month before last
questions.answer:
Will they fly to Rome the month after next?
No, they won't. They flew to Rome the month before last.

questions.prompt: 8. she/stay in Berlin/next October/last October
questions.answer:
Will she stay in Berlin next October?
No, she won't. She stayed in Berlin last October.

questions.prompt: 9. he/work in Sydney/next year/last year
questions.answer:
Will he work in Sydney next year?
No, he won't. He worked in Sydney last year.

questions.prompt: 10. you/see the film/tomorrow/yesterday
questions.answer:
Will you see the film tomorrow?
No, I won't. I saw the film yesterday.

grammar.title: II. Complete the dialogues, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词完成下列对话。
grammar.instruction:
Complete the dialogues, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词完成下列对话。

Example (item 1):
When will you go to Moscow? (next Friday)
I shall go to Moscow next Friday.
Who will go with you? (my boss)
My boss will go with me.
grammar.translation: Complete each dialogue using the cues in parentheses, following the printed example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf
grammar.context: 10 items. Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the supplied Lesson 93 grammar key (PDF 新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf, viewer p. 509).

______

______

questions.prompt:

questions.prompt:
